theorem finiteOpenTensor_isIso {X U : Scheme.{t}} (j : X ⟶ U) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (n : ℕ) : IsIso (finiteOpenTensor d j n)

title: Invertibility of the finite open tensor mate
statement: For the finite quotient coefficient datum and a quasi-compact open immersion j : X ⟶ U, the prescribed finite open tensor mate finiteOpenTensor d j n is an isomorphism for every n : ℕ.

source.place: Finite reduction/unit subcalculation in the proof of lem-cbc-completed-support-intermediate-tower; the two component obligations isolated from finiteUnits.

proof.text: Unfold the specified reduction/pullback comparison as the inverse mate of proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback.inv under the two scalar-extension adjunctions. The inverse mate defining finiteOpenTensor is therefore a double inverse mate. Mathlib iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv_symm identifies it with inverse conjugation under the composite endpoint-open/scalar-extension and scalar-extension/finite-open adjunctions. The original restriction/pullback map is an isomorphism, and conjugation preserves isomorphisms. No equivalence of the ambient open adjunctions is required.
